newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Network Ten appoints McAlpine CEO.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Network Ten appoints McAlpine CEO.

text.p: Australia's third-ranked television group, the privately-held Network Ten, said on Thursday that John McAlpine will become chief executive officer from July 1.
He will replace Peter Viner, an employee of Canada's CanWest Global Communications Corp, who is returning to Canada.
McAlpine was general manager of sales at the network, which ranks behind Seven Network Ltd and the Nine Network, which is owned by Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd.
Canwest is the largest shareholder in Network Ten with a 76 percent stake but has been ordered by the Australian government to reduce this to 57.5 percent before the end of calendar 1997.
